name: Extract selected b-values from DWI
summary: Extracts the DWI volumes of a chosen b-value shell, with matching bvals and bvecs, using MRtrix3 dwiextract.
description: Runs dwiextract -shell on the DWI to keep only the volumes of the target b-value (default 0, the b0 volumes). Use it to get b0 or single-shell images from multi-shell DWI. Warning: separate.sh reads the config key bval while the parameter is target_bval, and main checks dwi/dwi.nii.gz while the script writes nodif/, so the App fails as committed; the README describes the older b0/non-b0 split App.

inputs.description: The path to the DWI datatype

parameters.description: b-value of the shell to extract (0 for b0 volumes); currently not read by separate.sh, which reads the key bval.

citations.text: Tournier J-D, et al. MRtrix3: A fast, flexible and open software framework for medical image processing and visualisation. NeuroImage 202:116137 (2019).

failure_modes.fix: separate.sh writes to nodif/ but main checks dwi/dwi.nii.gz, and the parameter key differs (target_bval vs bval); both must be fixed in the code.
